summary.content:
Today's selection covers 93 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 62 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Critical Rails Bug Threatens to Derail Vulnerable Servers
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Vercel rolls out new protection against stolen session cookie attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 54 articles published in the last 24 hours
